'''Lorik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi instructor|combat instructor]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A tan-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Lorik wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|armored robes]] of white and gold while also carrying a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He was stationed on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where he could be found in the building known as the [[Hall of Learning]] on the grounds of [[Castle Organa]], the home of the Republic-allied [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Lorik first appeared in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a trainer for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class on Alderaan.<ref name="TOR" /> His location is also identified in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', which was released concurrently with the game in [[2011]].<ref name="Explore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
